lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Eight distinct white vertical line segments are visible across the lateral torso. Spacing is uneven: a tight cluster of three lines occupies the anterior/shoulder region, followed by two widely spaced lines in the central torso, and three lines in the posterior section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The fourth and sixth lines from the anterior shoulder are abbreviated, terminating mid-flank without reaching the ventral hair fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct high-contrast white spots are visible on the posterior haunch, arranged in a loose triangular formation approximately midway between the dorsal line and the hock.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory, emerging from the skull with an outward lateral vector before curving inward and slightly anterior at the distal ends.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 1.7 times the combined pixel width of the horn bases at the pedicles.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping is visible on the apical points, representing approximately 0.12 of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white chevron-shaped marking is located between the eyes; sharp transition from dark brown/charcoal pelage to orange/tan pelage on all four limbs below the knee and hock joints.
